title: Krawtchouk generating identity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. For every $\rho\in[-1,1]$, the sum of the degree-$j$ Krawtchouk values at $x$, weighted by $\rho^j$ for $0\le j\le n$, equals $2^n$ times the probability that independently flipping each coordinate of $x$ with correlation parameter $\rho$ produces the all-ones vector.
